feedback.problem:
Find all real eigenvalues of the matrix
$M=[\begin{aligned}-4 & 5 \\ 5 & -4\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's start by writing the matrix $M-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
M-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}-4-\lambda  & 5 \\ 5 & -4-\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

Now, let's find and solve the characteristic equation $det(M-\lambda I)=0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}-4-\lambda  & 5 \\ 5 & -4-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-4-\lambda )(-4-\lambda )-5\cdot 5 & =0 \\ 16+4\lambda +4\lambda +{\lambda }^{2}-25 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{2}+8\lambda -9 & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Using the quadratic formula, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\lambda  & =\frac{-8\pm \sqrt{{8}^{2}+4\cdot 1\cdot 9}}{2} \\  & =\frac{-8\pm \sqrt{100}}{2} \\  & =\frac{-8\pm 10}{2} \\  & =1,-9.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the eigenvalues are $\lambda =1$ and $\lambda =-9.$
